usageNotes: Use this to deactivate and remove an ACME account registration from Proxmox Datacenter Manager; the CA (e.g. Let's Encrypt) will be notified to deactivate the account before local data is deleted. Requires the System.Modify privilege on the system/certificates path. Returns a UPID — poll the task log to confirm completion before assuming the account is gone.
destructiveReason: Permanently deactivates the ACME account at the CA and deletes its local credentials; any certificates that relied on this account can no longer be renewed without re-registering.
tips: The `force` flag deletes local account data even if the CA returns an error during deactivation — use only when the account is already gone at the CA side and you need to clean up stale local state.
Because the response is a UPID, use a task-status endpoint to verify the deactivation completed without error before treating the account as removed.
Ensure no active certificate orders reference this account before deleting; orphaned orders will fail renewal silently.
